correctness.rationale: The normalized semicircle orthogonality and the exact Chebyshev product identity give the fourth coefficients (m+1,n+1,6(m+1)), with cubic cross terms killed by parity. Maximizing the resulting one-variable quadratic proves the exact norm and all three mode-selection cases. The completed-square identity proves strict interior attainment; endpoint derivatives and the opposite-parity exclusion prove sharp boundaries. Every nonzero input fourth moment decreases strictly under positive heat time, yielding the unique contraction threshold. The included standalone rational checker independently tests exact polynomial integrals and the optimization, without substituting finite checks for the universal argument.

originality.rationale: The full time-dependent two-eigenspace Jacobi L2-to-L4 norm and the exact critical index-ratio phases, including wide gaps, are not statements of the inspected classical Jacobi semigroup work or the asymptotic central-character packet result. The latter supplies a related exact unweighted fourth-moment intersection expansion when packet offsets are fixed and sufficiently small relative to degree, but does not furnish the finite weighted semigroup maximum or its parameter phase diagram. The classical Chebyshev fusion identity is acknowledged, not claimed.

value.rationale: Hypercontractive norm behavior on eigenmode restrictions is a natural functional-analytic stability question. The all-degree-pair all-time classification demonstrates three structural phases, including reentrant extremizer mixing driven by a sharp ratio window 3a<b<9a, and a direct pure-to-pure switch for wide gaps. Both are exact intrinsic spectral boundaries, not arbitrary parameter slices; the resulting criterion determines the exact restricted contraction time.
